activity.notes: ATLAS uses c.27 BCE as a bounded representative intellectual-activity point for Livy in Rome, near the beginning of his great historical work. The date is approximate and is not treated as an authorship or life boundary.

sources.title: Titus Livius (Livy), Ab Urbe Condita, Introduction — Perseus Digital Library
sources.citation_text: The introduction places Livy in Rome when he began his great historical work at about 27 BCE and notes his long residence there.
